s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive vision loss with macular changes and edema
salient_findings: Severe macular changes with associated edema
key_facts: Vision loss in the right eye
Ophthalmoscopic examination revealed severe macular changes

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive vision loss with macular changes and edema
salient_findings: Severe macular changes with associated edema
key_facts: Vision loss in the right eye
Ophthalmoscopic examination revealed severe macular changes

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of vision loss, severe macular changes, and associated edema, along with the spectral-domain optical coherence tomography findings showing persistent central macular thickness and changes in macular edema, are most consistent with cystoid macular edema, especially given the reversible effect on cystoid macular edema mentioned in the image description.

rejected.label: Central retinal vein occlusion
rejected.why: While the patient has a history of multiple strokes and vision loss, the primary findings of severe macular changes and associated edema do not directly point to central retinal vein occlusion as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Epiretinal membrane
rejected.why: There is no specific mention of an epiretinal membrane in the provided case facts, making it less likely to be the primary diagnosis.

rejected.label: Age-related macular degeneration
rejected.why: The patient's age and symptoms could suggest age-related macular degeneration, but the specific findings of cystoid macular edema and its reversible effect under different treatment conditions make this diagnosis less likely.

rejected.label: Branch retinal vein occlusion
rejected.why: Similar to central retinal vein occlusion, the provided case facts do not directly support branch retinal vein occlusion as the primary diagnosis, especially with the emphasis on cystoid macular edema in the findings.
